description: Státní pozemkový úřad: drainage datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Státní pozemkový úřad. Coverage: Státní pozemkový úřad. The listing groups 28 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drainage; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Meliorační stavby (linie) - Jihomoravský kraj; Meliorační stavby (linie) - Moravskoslezský kraj; Meliorační stavby (linie) - Zlínský kraj; Meliorační stavby (body) - Pardubický kraj. Formats seen: SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/01312774/1012423364/distribuce/76c9566d968044d6fe4bd021a870f173/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/01312774/1012455745/distribuce/216265a0796e5d69a5a60a54fd3e4434/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/01312774/1012456012/distribuce/8e678ce4d0c70872c9825ac5fb127a18/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
